QuestInfo.name: [Mushroom Shrine Tales] Making Nue Friends
QuestInfo.0: Speak to Nue at the Mushroom Shrine about becoming his friend.
QuestInfo.1: Nue asks you to bring Ibaraki to him, but you may need to be on better terms with Ibaraki first.
QuestInfo.2: You took Ibaraki to see Nue. It looks like Nue is steamed that Ibaraki interrupted his confession to Takeno Konoko. Oh my.
